item.title: Static Pricing for Multi-Unit Prophet Inequalities
item.description: On Tuesday, I had the pleasure of seeing Nikhil Devanur present Static pricing for multi-unit prophet inequalities, which is joint with Thodoris Lykouris and Shuchi Chawla. I liked the work, and want to bring it to other’s attention. In this post, I describe some of the main ideas in the paper. An accompanying post presents some new results that I derived after seeing the talk. 1 The Setting You are presented with a sequence of \(n\) values \(V_1, \ldots, V_n\).
